title: Common definitions
description: Shared building blocks for every «Инспектор ИИ» contract schema. Owner: AG-00.

Sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the plaintext bytes, no prefix (90 §3.3.6).

ManifestFileId.description: Manifest file id: organizer F0001…F0418, or U<8 hex of the upload>-<4 digits> for a user upload (ad-hoc registry, inspector_registry.adhoc).

FileId.description: Any file id: a manifest id, a product registry id, or a virtual archive-member id «F0150!path».

CitableFileId.description: A file id that may be cited as evidence: never an archive member (no «!»).

CanonicalParameterCode.description: Catalog code (97 §2.9): PZ-001 … SM-132. Aliases (M-xxx, KR-55, КР-55) are never emitted.

SubmissionParameterCode.description: A code allowed in a submission: canonical catalog code or FREE-<TOPIC>-<NNN>.

ParamId.description: Catalog parameter id, the join key for every code style.

PageNumber.description: 1-based physical page index of the original PDF (not the printed sheet number).

SheetNumber.description: Printed «Лист» from the title block, kept as printed.

BBoxNorm.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF_VISIBLE_ROTATED_TL_V1 space (02 §3.14): visible area CropBox ∩ MediaBox after /Rotate, origin top-left, y down, values in [0, 1].

PolygonNorm.description: Vertices clockwise from the top-left vertex, same space as BBoxNorm.

Location.description: Exact printed token («012», «1.109», «-1.05»), FLOOR/BUILDING/AXES grammar (93 §2.7), or «OBJECT».

StageValue.description: pd_value / rd_value / id_value: rendered by the value templates (93 §3.5); null when the stage is not part of the check.

CriticalityString.description: Exact catalog criticality string; the FREE-* variant carries «— требует утверждения».

Versions.description: Versions block (90 §3.3.6), identical in run, protocol, submission sidecar and exports.

code_version.description: git commit (short or full), with «+dirty» when the tree is dirty.

Extension.description: Escape hatch for experimental, non-contract data. Never read by another agent's code and never exported.
